note: Toolbox modules an app can depend on. status: exists = a workspace package under app/packages with its own version; partial = the package exists but part of the module still lives inside another package or the demo app, or only the code exists elsewhere; planned = no code yet. 'today' lists the real source paths (relative to the lacuna repo root).

modules.summary: Document model (title, body, comments, revisions), DocsEditor, read-only DocSurface, and the import/export interface every document format plugs into.

modules.summary: Format table (PDF, DOCX, PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, SVG, ZIP, HTML, text, TeX) and detect(bytes, filename): magic bytes decide, the extension only names unsigned formats or explains a mismatch. modules.summary: Conversion registry: converters register { from, to, convert }; apps call convert(from, to, input). Built-in text ↔ PlainDocument. DOCX → document registers from @lacuna/docx. Convert app is the first consumer.
modules.gap: No route() for multi-hop chains yet. PDF, HTML, and TeX converters are not registered.

modules.summary: Unit conversion registry: length, mass, temperature (offset), volume, time, and data (1000 vs 1024). Apps call categories(), units(), convert() — never throw past the API.
modules.gap: No currency or compound units yet. Sheets column formatting does not call this module yet.

modules.summary: Viewer registry and FilePreview: reads a local file, detects it through @lacuna/formats, refuses oversized files before reading them, lazy-loads the registered viewer, and shows conversion notes and unreadable, locked, unsupported, empty, and too-large states. FileDrop is the matching drop area and picker.
modules.gap: Previews local files only; no 'Open with' menu over stored records yet, and nothing opened is saved.

modules.summary: docxImporter (DOCX to sanitized DocModel) and docxViewer for FilePreview; docxToDocument registers on @lacuna/convert. mammoth loads only when a DOCX is opened. Planned: docxExporter, readFields, fillFields.
modules.gap: Import and convert-to-document only. Images are counted and omitted (DocModel has no image block); page layout, headers, footers, footnotes, and comments are not carried. No export, no field read or fill.

modules.summary: openPdf (page count, page sizes, draw a page to a canvas) on pdf.js, and pdfViewer for FilePreview with pages drawn as they scroll into view. pdf.js and its worker load only when a PDF is opened. modules.gap: Render only: no text layer or search, no annotation or link layer, password-protected PDFs refused. Standard-font, CMap, and wasm assets are not shipped, so non-embedded fonts fall back to system fonts and JPEG 2000 images may not draw.

modules.summary: Image decode and preview (app/packages/image): validates and measures PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, and SVG with the browser's decoders, refuses oversized canvases from the header before decoding, shows SVG only through an img element.
